product.ta-21-mbke.summary: The TA 21/MBKE collected data on magnetic cassette for later processing.
product.ta-21-mbke.history: Triumph-Adler included it in its data-entry range alongside the diskette-based TA 21/FDE.
product.ta-21-mbke.technical.configurati: The cassette also loaded workstation programs. The manual describes this operation with the MBKE 1 drive.
product.ta-21-mbke.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-21-mbke.technical.limitations: Firmware from an identified unit and program media are still needed to check operation.
